description: This PHP script generates a popup interface for rescheduling a call within the SuiteCRM system. It retrieves call details, processes user preferences for date and time formats, and dynamically creates form controls for selecting new date and time values, along with reason options.

classes.name: Call
classes.description: Represents a call entity within the system, with a method to retrieve call details.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific call based on its ID.
